notes.title: Replacement of FSR 2.2 with XeSS 1.3
notes.notes:
We have replaced FSR 2.2 with XeSS 1.3. This is to allow better image quality when using upscaling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967685/9eedab89e839cd8542b625654efd18258a21b0cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DirectX 12 / VULKAN / FSR 2.2 compatible
notes.notes:
Bonjour,

Good morning,

We are happy to announce that Age Of Albuvia is now compatible with AMD's SFR 2.2 technology.

You will therefore now be able to play games without sacrificing graphics if you do not have a graphics card capable enough to run the game with maximum details.

The game is also compatible with Vulkan. You can therefore choose the graphics API directly from the game options.

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

See you soon for new adventures!

Don't worry, I'll get them translated into English when it's finished.

notes.title: Happy New Year 2023!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi there,[/b]

We wish you a happy new year 2023 full of happiness and video games. We take this opportunity to give you some news about the game!

The first world is almost complete. We still need to work on a few details and some side quests, but this one is largely finished.
The second world is well advanced in terms of history and its modeling. There are still a few weeks of work before starting the last final world which should be the smallest.

Of course, [b]we continue to evolve the gameplay[/b]. You now have access to the list of secondary quests in order to be able to identify them more easily and know their progress. But there are many more surprises yet to come.

The game will release well this year and we hope you enjoy it.

Happy New Year everyone !

notes.title: Become a farmer!
notes.notes:
Hello to all the community.

The game continues to have new features. Today, we are happy to announce that the cultivation of your field is operational.

And it's accessible in the demo !

So you can plant sunflowers and harvest them.

See you soon !

notes.title: Presentation of Age Of Albuvia - A small Open World RPG directed by a gamer
notes.notes:
Come discover the world of [b] Albuvia [/b], where magic once existed. I [b] play a young mage [/b] and go in search of Albuvia's past in order to better understand his past. This will surely allow you to understand why the forces of evil have decided to return.

[b] The game is not over [/b], but take advantage of the Steam Neo Fest event to come and chat live with the game's creator and start to see what awaits you in this little Open World RPG.

Developed by an old-school gamer, this game will of course not include any microtransaction, no paytowin.

[b] This little RPG with shimmering colors and decorations [/b] already reflects its personality through its gameplay or its universe.

So be there, the developer will be listening and answer all your questions (English and French).

Hope to see you all there.

notes.title: Release of the first technical demo
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are pleased to announce the release of the game’s first beta demo. You can start playing and roam the beautiful lands of Albuvia (French only for the moment).

The start of the main quest is available as well as some side quests. The side quests are bound to evolve over time, so keep an eye out for updates!

Good game everyone, hope this first glimpse of the game makes you want to see the rest!

Join us on our discord to share this wonderful adventure together!
